counterfactual.change: Reduced initial vx from -52.44 to -20.0 (single field) to lower per-step displacement below tunneling threshold, collision detection then succeeds

explanation: High-speed body tunnels through thin wall: substep count (39) insufficient for displacement (~1.02 m per step vs wall thickness). At step 23 body is just outside wall (distance +0.565), at step 24 it has passed through and is inside overlap -0.37 exceeding 0.15 tolerance. Reducing speed prevents tunneling, confirming substep/discrete collision handling as cause.
vision_note: The red circle moves leftward toward the dark grey wall, sitting just outside its right edge through step 23. At step 24 it is visibly overlapping and embedded inside the wall's right side instead of bouncing or stopping outside.
